Common base of the services that receive a UserId.
Loads the User through IUserRepository and asks
AccessPolicy. It depends on abstractions, not on another
service. If access is denied it throws AccessDenied.

+tagFile(u : UserId, id : ItemId, e : Tag) : void
the event bus (EventBusAdapter) is the only
owner of the observer list. CompositionRoot
registers this observer at startup. For each
CatalogEvent it writes to IChangeLog, which
SyncService reads from. Neither knows the other.
catalog is an observer of its own on the bus, so the
bus stays the only owner of the list. It passes on
the CatalogChanges the person can see (user and
catalog read again each time); removals go to
everyone. Closing the subscription unsubscribes it.
implements the same driving port as the service it
wraps and passes every call on to it. When the call
changes something, it records an AuditEntry in the
same unit of work; if the call throws, nothing is
recorded. Reads are passed on untouched.
CompositionRoot hands the primary adapters the
decorators, so the services know nothing about it.

+save(u : UserId, file : ItemId, text : String, basedOn : Fingerprint) : TextDocument
merged in the browsers; the server only reads and
saves the text. A save writes the file and records
its new fingerprint in the catalog (FileModified);
if the catalog is not saved, it writes the old text
back. The same text again changes nothing; another
text based on an old fingerprint is a VersionConflict.
